svg.title: James Emmrich · GitHub profile
svg.desc: Founder, zero-to-one product builder, and technical leader. Featured project: Ideate, a visual workspace for brainstorming, research, and planning. Other projects include Asteroids and a Rust vocabulary tool.

text.tspan: I take products from an open question to software people use. I prototype,
write code and operate what I ship end-to-end. I’ve also led full-stack teams
and built event-driven systems for production environments at scale.
and next steps together on one canvas.
